The Villa

Frontline to the Mediterranean

A newly built frontline villa with direct access to the sea and breathtaking views of the coastline.

Offered exclusively by Imperial Properties, this villa sits on the front line in the prestigious area of Sol de Mallorca, with five bedrooms and seven bathrooms.

Built and finished to the highest specification in 2024, it brings together what is almost impossible to find here: a frontline position, direct access to the sea, top quality and a newly built home.

Outdoors

Terraces over the sea

Outdoor living is a delight, with several terraces, all with outstanding sea views, and a swimming pool overlooking the open water, perfect for relaxing or entertaining.

A sea platform gives direct access to the Mediterranean, right at the new owners' doorstep. Below the pool is a separate apartment with its own wonderful views.
